targets.rawSql: SELECT '$season' AS season, '$team' AS team, ROUND(AVG(avg_points), 2) AS avg_points, ROUND(AVG(avg_rebounds), 2) AS avg_rebounds, ROUND(AVG(avg_assists), 2) AS avg_assists, ROUND(AVG(avg_steals), 2) AS avg_steals, ROUND(AVG(avg_blocks), 2) AS avg_blocks, ROUND(AVG(avg_fouls), 2) AS avg_fouls, ROUND(AVG(avg_played_minutes), 2) AS avg_played_minutes, MAX(updated_at) AS updated_at FROM team_players_season_stats('$season', '$team');

list.name: season
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT season FROM season_player_stats_report ORDER BY season DESC

list.name: team
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT team FROM season_player_stats_report WHERE season = '$season' ORDER BY team

list.name: player
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT player_name FROM season_player_stats_report WHERE season = '$season' AND team = '$team' ORDER BY player_name
